_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The analyst's forward call to Disbelief is adopted as consensus — a one-rung step up the ladder — but direction stays HOLD because the specific breakers needed for UP (funding >0.012% + retail velocity >60 + 30d momentum positive) or DOWN (VIX >16 + DXY >100 + exchange reserves dropping) are both absent, making a forced directional guess in this coil a losing base-rate play.
next_move.brains_agree: No — the narrative writer implies a bearish reversal setup while the analyst explicitly refuses a directional call; the split is resolved by siding with the analyst's higher trust weight and the absence of any triggered breaker.
next_move.confirmed_if: Funding sustains above 0.012% AND retail_noise_velocity breaks above 60 AND btc_momentum_30d turns positive (UP confirmation) OR VIX closes above 16 with DXY reclaiming 100 and exchange reserves dropping below 60 (DOWN confirmation — either breaker resolves the coil)
next_move.invalidated_if: Score drifts below 32 entering Panic territory (bearish resolution without the macro breaker firing) OR above 39 entering Anxiety with sustained momentum (bullish resolution invalidating the Denial framing)
